qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Niche private client and specialized corporate lending franchise provides localized relationship strength, but lacks pricing power against larger wealth managers and suffers from persistent South African Rand currency depreciation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Pricing Power & Moat Proof, REJECT). Mid-sized specialist bank and wealth manager lacking structural pricing power. Operates in competitive, commoditized lending markets and fee-compressed wealth management, with substantial earnings exposure to the South African Rand and emerging-market macro volatility.
qualitative.evidence: Investec operates across the UK and South Africa (~50% operating profit from Southern Africa). Group ROTE historically averaged 10-14%, heavily dependent on South African macro conditions and Rand exchange rates. Wealth management fees face ongoing industry-wide fee compression, and specialist lending offers zero independent pricing power above benchmark rates.
